definitions.name: Z1D.MOD
definitions.body: 'Z1D.MB' BIND 'Z1D.MA' BIND Z1D.MA Z1D.MA Z1D.MB DIV FLOOR Z1D.MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a mod b (floor remainder); lifts over a Vector a

definitions.name: Z1D.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

definitions.name: Z1D.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'Z1D.X' BIND [ 'Z1D.C' 'Z1D.S' ] BIND Z1D.C 1 EQ 'Z1D.D' BIND Z1D.C Z1D.C 2 DIV Z1D.C 3 MUL 1 ADD Z1D.C 2 Z1D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT Z1D.D SELECT Z1D.S Z1D.S 1 ADD Z1D.D SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step: [ current steps ] dummy -> one Collatz step, staying put once current is 1

definitions.name: Z1D.BDELTA
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'Z1D.K' BIND 1 -1 '()[]' Z1D.K SEARCH 2 Z1D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 for an opener, -1 for a closer

definitions.name: Z1D.NILMASK
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector of 1 where the element is NIL, 0 where present

definitions.name: Z1D.LINE
definitions.body: 'Z1D.O' BIND Z1D.O 'price' GET 0 Z1D.O 'price' HAS? SELECT Z1D.O 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: Z1D.QBS
definitions.body: 'Z1D.OS' BIND Z1D.OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP Z1D.OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'Z1D.G' BIND Z1D.G KEYS Z1D.G VALUES [ Z1D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record sku -> total qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: Z1D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER 'Z1D.CW' BIND Z1D.CW CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER Z1D.CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

solutions.runs.rle: X1.GUFIMI [ 'Z1D.R' BIND Z1D.R 0 GET Z1D.R LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'Z1D.V' BIND Z1D.V Z1D.V 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'Z1D.E' BIND [ 'Z1D.PV' 'Z1D.ST' ] BIND Z1D.E Z1D.ST 1 ADD 1 Z1D.E Z1D.PV GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.second_largest: UNIQUE SORT 'Z1D.U' BIND Z1D.U -2 GET NIL Z1D.U LENGTH 1 GT SELECT
solutions.runs.majority: 'Z1D.V' BIND Z1D.V TALLY 'Z1D.T' BIND Z1D.T VALUES 'Z1D.C' BIND Z1D.T KEYS Z1D.C ORDER -1 GET GET NIL Z1D.C 0 [ MAX ] FOLD 2 MUL Z1D.V LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.number.primes: 'Z1D.N' BIND 1 Z1D.N RANGE [ X1.LAVIPA LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.number.binary: [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] DIV FLOOR 2 Z1D.MOD STR JOIN 'Z1D.S' BIND Z1D.S CHARS Z1D.S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 0 2 COLLECT 'Z1D.A' BIND 1 130 RANGE Z1D.A [ Z1D.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'Z1D.S' BIND 0 Z1D.S CHARS LENGTH RANGE [ 'Z1D.L' BIND Z1D.S CHARS Z1D.L TAKE JOIN X1.TODIPU '' EQ ] FILTER -1 GET
solutions.sensor.present_mean: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'Z1D.P' BIND Z1D.P Z1D.SUM Z1D.P LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'Z1D.V' BIND Z1D.V Z1D.V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'Z1D.E' BIND 'Z1D.AC' BIND Z1D.E Z1D.AC Z1D.E NIL? NOT SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: Z1D.NILMASK X1.GUFIMI [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: Z1D.NILMASK X1.GUFIMI [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER [ LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'Z1D.V' BIND Z1D.V 1 DROP Z1D.V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'Z1D.V' BIND Z1D.V Z1D.V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER SORT -1 GET DIV
solutions.orders.unpriced: X1.MULAFA [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.top_sku: X1.MULAFA Z1D.QBS 'Z1D.Q' BIND Z1D.Q KEYS Z1D.Q VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.orders.tag_counts: X1.MULAFA [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.top_word: LOWER X1.SEBUFE TALLY 'Z1D.T' BIND Z1D.T KEYS Z1D.T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: X1.SEBUFE [ Z1D.CAP ] MAP X1.FAGAMO
